description: Adopt a foreign app as-is: its source runs unchanged from upstream/ behind the sidecar A2App adapter (@a2app/reverse-proxy), which starts it from sidecar.json, serves the A2App surface on the app's port, and forwards each declared operation to one of the app's own routes. Operate-only: no entities. NOT part of the framework.

gate.name: sidecar.json valid; operations resolve (every declared op maps onto a route of the adopted app)
